additional_info.subject: RE: 0406447 - ID0406447-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP / R8 170002426] Charger out of order CRM:02023000503
additional_info.body:
Hello Sadek,
There was a COAP polling error, which caused the outlet to be out of order. Internal communication with the SECC was briefly lost.
SiC D will reconnect to the SECC within 5 seconds. During the time the SECC is unreachable, the "Outlet out of order" flag will remain active and will be cleared once SiC D successfully reconnects. Additionally, the HMI may occasionally display a "preparing" status. Our R&D team is currently working on a fix for this, which will be included in the upcoming firmware version.
Please let me know if you have any questions or if we can proceed with the closure.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.
